offering_description.value: Byrna sells less-lethal launchers, projectiles and sprays for personal protection and professional security. It reaches customers through its website and authorized dealers.

quotes.quote: Our mission is to provide civilians and security professionals with safe, reliable, and effective less-lethal alternatives to traditional firearms that empower Byrna owners to protect and defend themselves, their families, and their communities without the need for lethal force. We aim to provide technology-based systems and solutions that help protect Byrna owners in their homes, their vehicles, and in public.

primary_products.value: CO₂-powered launchers; chemical irritant projectiles; kinetic projectiles; self-defense sprays

quotes.quote: Byrna launchers give you two ways to stop a threat. Chemical irritant projectiles burst on impact, dispersing a cloud of pepper and/or tear gas powder capable of disabling an attacker for up to 30 minutes. Kinetic projectiles are hard, solid rounds that deliver intense impact — with enough force to break a car's side window from 30 feet away. And you can do it all from up to 60 feet, keeping distance between you and the threat.

quotes.quote: Take the 60-second quiz → Shop all products →

From the earliest days of Byrna, our driving force has been the desire to save lives. We knew that to make a real impact, we needed to create a product that was not only safe and reliable but also accessible and easy to use. The development of the Byrna launcher was a labor of love, fueled by countless hours of research, testing, and refinement. Since its launch, the feedback we have received from our customers has been both humbling and incredibly rewarding. Hearing stories of how our product has empowered individuals to protect themselves and their loved ones, without causing irreversible harm, reaffirms our commitment to our mission and fuels our passion to continue innovating and expanding our product range. We are deeply grateful to be part of a movement that is making a positive impact on the world and are committed to continuing our work with passion and dedication.
